svg.title: Privacy and utility under five prompting methods

cc:Work.dc:title: Privacy and utility under five prompting methods
cc:Work.dc:description: Mobile layout of Table 5, arXiv:2601.08235v3. Same values as the desktop chart. Mistral-Large-3 and Qwen3-VL-8B panels compare five methods. Upper left means low negative-case image leakage and high positive-case visual utility.
